verticalDatum: Native official Estonian DTM EH2000/EVRS reference; independent geoid comparison to the operator’s published sea-level tower elevations remains unverified.
sourceRasterEncoding: Float32 EPSG3301, one-meter DTM. Bilinear center sampling; crop has no nodata.

sources.transform: axis order change (2D) + Inverse of EST97 to WGS 84 (1) + Estonian National Grid + axis order change (2D)
sources.acquisitionRange: Official latest DTM generation 2021–2024 ALS; exact Toompea cell flight date unverified.

limits: One-meter native cells resampled to four-meter diagnostic ground; cell size is not surveyed positional accuracy. Latest DTM spans2021–2024; exact local acquisition date unverified.
Castle floors, roof/eave heights and northern block datums are fitting approximations. Buried bounded foundation is not a copied surveyed cliff mesh. No terrain cutout.

Operator gives Tall Hermann stone crown83m and flag top95m above sea; derivative uses these approximate absolute controls, preserving45.6m mapped shaft and12m mast. The datum conversion to EH2000 and detailed corbels are unverified.
DTM crop is original public ground data; no meshes or photographic textures downloaded. Surrounding gardens, cathedral and town remain excluded.
